counts.document_gate_scope: 72 generated files are shared integration/regression cases, not independent holdout performance data

labeling.actionability: exposure is separate from structure; public documentation JWE examples remain format positives; standalone exposure stays unknown
labeling.clean_negative: 10,000 predeclared examples contain no valid compact JOSE structure; malformed derivatives are adversarial and never TNs
labeling.grouping: template_family and seed_id are disjoint across dev and holdout; split labels are fixed before detector runs
labeling.jwe_target: positive is an intact supported five-part RFC 7516 compact JWE; JWS candidates remain JWE negatives and are separately labeled in other_spans
labeling.jws_target: intact supported three-part compact JWS candidate, measured separately from the JWE target
labeling.rendering_fingerprints: computed from each concrete generated wrapper normalized only at known synthetic value spans plus the parsed protected-header member shape
labeling.span: half-open Unicode codepoint offsets around exactly the compact JWE/JWS candidate
